title: Greenhouse integration (ATS & HRMS) | Xobin
text:
Why integrate Greenhouse with Xobin?
Integrating Greenhouse with Xobin streamlines your recruitment process by seamlessly combining Greenhouse’s applicant tracking system with Xobin’s powerful skill assessment platform. This integration allows you to invite candidates to assessments, track their progress, and view detailed results directly within Greenhouse. It eliminates manual tasks, enhances evaluation accuracy, and ensures a more efficient, data-driven hiring process.
Steps to Integrate Greenhouse with Xobin
Integrating Xobin with Greenhouse streamlines your hiring process by allowing you to manage candidate assessments seamlessly. Follow these simple steps to set up the integration and send assessment invites.
Setting Up the Integration
1. Generate the API Key in Xobin
Log in to your Xobin dashboard and navigate to the
Settings
page.
Go to the
Integration
tab and select
Greenhouse
from the available integration options.
Click on the
Generate API Key
button, and once the key is generated, copy it to your clipboard.
2. Enable the Integration in Greenhouse
Access your Greenhouse dashboard and navigate to the
Integrations
Search for
Xobin Integration
and click on it.
Press the
Connect
button, and when prompted, paste the API key you copied from Xobin.
Click
Save
to complete the setup.
Sending Assessment Invites and Managing Scores
1. Send Assessment Invites
In Greenhouse, locate the candidate you want to assess and navigate to their
To-Do
tab.
Select the linked Xobin assessment from the list and click the
Send
button.
Confirm the candidate’s email, assessment name, and designated scorer in the pop-up prompt.
Click the
Send Test
button to send the assessment invite.
2. Track and Review Candidate Scores
Once the invite is sent, the Xobin assessment will appear under the
Pending
After the candidate completes the assessment, their score will move to the
Submitted Tests
section. You will also receive an email notification with the scoring details.
Navigate to the
Completed
tab in the candidate’s Greenhouse profile to view the results.
3. Access Detailed Performance Reports
In the
tab, click
View Interview Kit
to get an overview of the candidate’s performance.
For a comprehensive analysis, click
View Report
, which redirects you to Xobin’s detailed report page.
The report includes:
Overall score and performance summary.
Strength-wise analysis.
Section-wise and question-wise results.
Candidate log details for the test session.
Who is this integration for?
This integration is designed for HR professionals, recruiters, and talent acquisition teams who use Greenhouse for applicant tracking and want to enhance their hiring process with Xobin’s advanced skill assessments. It’s ideal for organizations seeking to automate candidate evaluation, improve hiring accuracy, and make data-driven decisions effortlessly within their existing Greenhouse workflow.
Capabilities
Features & benefits
Invites from the candidate To-Do tab
Select a linked Xobin assessment on the candidate's To-Do tab in Greenhouse and send the invite in a couple of clicks.
Single API key setup
Generate an API key in Xobin Settings > Integration and paste it into the Xobin Integration in Greenhouse to connect both platforms.
Pending and submitted tracking
Invited assessments sit under Pending and move to Submitted Tests on completion, with an email notification containing the scoring details.
Scores on the Greenhouse profile
Completed results appear in the candidate's Completed tab, so scores live alongside the rest of your Greenhouse pipeline data.
Interview Kit and detailed reports
Open View Interview Kit for a quick performance overview, or View Report for Xobin's full analysis of the candidate.
Deep performance analysis
Reports cover the overall score and summary, strength-wise analysis, section and question-wise results, plus candidate log details for the session.
